segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Hey Jordan, quick forecast check before the 2:00. I have Cedar Ridge at $42,600 for 38 seats, annual, legal redlines came back pretty clean.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Yeah, I saw that. The only thing I flagged was the payment term. They asked for net 60 and our standard on that package is net 30.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Right. I told procurement we can do net 45 if they sign by August 9. Deal desk said that's fine, no pricing change.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Good. And implementation still wants the September 3 kickoff?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep. They have their ops lead out the last week of August, so September 3 is the first clean date. It keeps them on track for October 1 go-live.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Okay. Anything else weird in your patch?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Um, just noticed Harbor Lane's services agreement ends tomorrow, and I don't think anyone on our side has talked to them about continuing yet. Anyway, not part of this commit number.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Got it. For Cedar Ridge, can you make sure the order form shows 38 seats, $42,600, net 45, and the September 3 kickoff note?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Already updated the draft. I'll send you the final language after legal drops in the limitation of liability change.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Perfect. If Cedar Ridge signs this week, that's in August closed-won, not September, correct?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Correct. Signature date drives it, billing starts on go-live unless finance changes something, but they were fine with the October 1 start.
